_comment: Calls namespace: consultations, follow-ups, approvals, webinars and workshops. Serbian and Hungarian are drafts pending native speaker review.

consultation.waiting: Waiting for the other participant to join.
consultation.connectionLost: The connection was lost. Check your internet connection and join again.

followUp.proposedEmailBody: A follow-up session was proposed for {{date}} at {{time}}. Open NestSelf to confirm it, suggest other times or decline.
followUp.expertNote: The employee decides whether this time works. They can confirm it, suggest other times or decline.
followUp.timeZoneNote: Times are in the {{timeZone}} time zone.
followUp.waitingForEmployee: Waiting for the employee to answer.
followUp.employeeNote: You decide: confirm this time, suggest other times or decline.
followUp.awaitingApprovalBody: Your organisation approves follow-ups before they are booked. You will both be told when it is decided.
followUp.confirmedBody: Your follow-up is booked for {{date}} at {{time}}.
followUp.timesSuggested: You suggested other times. The expert will choose one of them.
followUp.suggestTitle: Suggest up to three times that suit you

errors.dateTimeRequired: Choose a date and a time.
errors.past: Choose a time in the future.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end time must be after the start time.

approval.missingApprover: No approver is assigned to this request.

webinar.lobby: Your camera stays off. You can write to the hosts and raise your hand to ask for the floor.
webinar.recordingNotice: This webinar is recorded. Only the presenters are on the recording.
webinar.recordingNoticeFloor: Your voice is part of the recording. Your camera stays off.
webinar.messageSubmitted: Your message was sent to the hosts. It appears in the chat only if a host publishes it.
webinar.floorGiven: A host gave you the floor.
webinar.floorTaken: The host took the floor back. Your microphone is off again.
webinar.youCanSpeakNow: You can speak now. Unmute to talk.
webinar.capacityAboveLimit: Capacity can be at most {{limit}} attendees until larger webinars are supported in milestone M3.

prejoin.checkingDevices: Checking your camera, microphone and connection…
prejoin.permissionHelp: If your browser blocked the camera or microphone, allow access in the site settings next to the address bar and reload the page.
prejoin.title: Check your camera and microphone
prejoin.description: Make sure everything works before you join.
prejoin.speaker: Speaker
prejoin.networkPoorHint: Your connection looks weak. During the call, video quality may drop or your video may pause so that the sound stays clear.
prejoin.networkOfflineHint: The connection check could not reach the internet. Check your connection, then check again.
prejoin.microphoneHint: Say something: the bar moves when your microphone picks you up.
prejoin.speakerQuestion: Did you hear the test sound?
prejoin.speakerNotHeard: Turn up the volume or choose another speaker, then play the sound again.
prejoin.speakerFailed: The test sound could not play. Check your speaker and try again.
prejoin.blurHint: Blur hides most of the room behind you, but not all of it. A private space is still best.
prejoin.blurUnavailable: Background blur is not available in this browser.
prejoin.cameraOffHint: You can turn your camera on during the call.

permissionDenied.chrome: Select the camera icon or the site settings icon in the address bar, allow the camera and microphone, then select Check again.
permissionDenied.edge: Select the lock icon in the address bar, open the permissions for this site, allow the camera and microphone, then select Check again.
permissionDenied.firefox: Select the crossed-out camera or microphone icon in the address bar, remove the block, then select Check again.
permissionDenied.safari: Open the settings for this website (on a Mac: Safari menu; on iPhone or iPad: the aA button), allow the camera and microphone, then select Check again.

prejoin.permissionHelpLink: How to allow access in your browser
prejoin.microphoneRequired: Your microphone is needed to join. Allow it in your browser, then check again.
prejoin.cameraError: Your camera could not start. Close other apps that use it, then check again.
prejoin.microphoneError: Your microphone could not start. Close other apps that use it, then check again.
prejoin.joinDisabledHint: You can join when the check is finished.

errors.joinWindowClosed: This session cannot be joined right now. Joining opens shortly before the start and closes after the scheduled end.
errors.appointmentNotJoinable: This appointment cannot be joined or changed in its current status.
errors.appointmentNotProposed: This proposal is no longer waiting for your answer.
errors.followUpNotAllowed: A follow-up can only be proposed after a completed session.
errors.approvalNotPending: This request has already been decided or has expired.
errors.approverMissing: Your organisation has not assigned anyone to approve follow-ups yet. Contact your HR team.
errors.videoProviderUnavailable: Video is not available right now. Please try again later.
errors.webinarNotOpen: This webinar cannot be joined right now.
errors.registrationClosed: Registration for this webinar is closed.
errors.alreadyRegistered: You are already registered for this webinar.
errors.notEligible: This webinar is not available to you.
errors.floorNotAvailable: The floor cannot be given to this participant right now.
errors.recordingNotAllowed: This recording action is not allowed.
errors.capacityAboveLimit: This capacity is above what a single webinar supports for now.
errors.invalidTicket: This link has expired or was already used. Open the appointment again to get a new one.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

controls.blurUnavailable: Background blur is not available in this browser.
controls.speaker: Speaker
controls.endConfirmTitle: End the consultation for both of you?

stage.remoteCameraOff: The other participant's camera is off

stage.removed: You were removed from this call.
stage.joinedElsewhere: You joined this call from another tab or device.

timer.label: Session time
timer.followUpHint: You can propose a follow-up on the screen after the call.
timer.roomClosing_one: The room will close in {{count}} minute.
timer.roomClosing_few: The room will close in {{count}} minutes.
timer.roomClosing_other: The room will close in {{count}} minutes.

crisis.title: Need urgent help?
crisis.body: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call the emergency number now.
crisis.disclaimer: NestSelf is not an emergency service. In an emergency, call 112.
crisis.expertTitle: If the employee may be in danger

expertSteps.stay: Stay in the call and stay calm. Do not end the session.
expertSteps.locate: Ask where they are right now and whether someone is with them.
expertSteps.call: Call 112 from another phone, give the address and stay with the employee until help arrives.
